candidates.description: These tokens represent common German grammatical particles, conjunctions, and pronominal adverbs.
This feature vector represents German modal and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, ability, permission, or desire.
This feature vector activates on capitalized nouns and technical terminology related to structural, systemic, or formal concepts.
This vector represents common German verb and noun prefixes, particularly past participle and nominalization markers starting with 'ge-'.
This feature vector activates strongly on words, prefixes, and morphological variations starting with the letters "ver" across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates strongly on roots, prefixes, and suffixes commonly found in European languages, particularly relating to technical, mechanical, or medical terminology.
This vector is related to common German adverbial words indicating time, place, and manner.
This vector activates on words ending with the letter sequence "-nk" or words sharing a similar phonetic and orthographic ending.
This vector represents words or word fragments ending in the German-style double 's' or similar sibilant consonant clusters.
This feature vector activates on words beginning with the letters "Al" or "als" in various capitalizations and linguistic contexts.
